lines.japanese: 俺よりすこし遅れて、鳳翔は靴音高くやってきた。低いテーブルを挟んだ向かい側の席へ、荒い息遣いと共に腰を落とす。
lines.english: Otori came in a little after me, his shoes ringing against the floor. Breathing hard, he dropped into the seat across the low table.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　聞きわけない俗人どもに焦らされたものだ。待ちわびたぞ、隼人」
lines.english: “Ha! Those obstinate commoners made me wait. I’ve been looking forward to this, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 俺はベンチにもたれたまま、鷹揚に腕組みした。
lines.english: I leaned back against the bench and folded my arms at my ease.

lines.japanese: 「よう暴君。なんで森里殴ったん」
lines.english: “Hey, tyrant. Why'd you hit Morisato?”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　捨てた犬が戻ってきたなら、元飼い主としては厳しく追いかえさなきゃならねえだろ？」
lines.english: “Huh? When a dog you’ve thrown out comes back, its old master has to be firm about driving it off. Doesn’t he?”

lines.japanese: 「捨てた犬」
lines.english: “A dog you cast out?”

lines.japanese: 「なんだそれ。いつ捨てたんだよ。おまえら、きのうは一緒にいたじゃん」
lines.english: “What's that supposed to mean? When did you throw him out? You were together yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 「なら、そのあとに決まってるだろう？　ハハハ！　普通の人間は、昨日と今日のあいだに異界で過ごす空白の時間なんてありはしないんだぜ」
lines.english: “Then it happened afterward, obviously. Ha ha ha! Ordinary people don’t spend the hours between yesterday and today in some other world.”

lines.japanese: グレタガルド。
lines.english: Gretagard.

lines.japanese: こいつは──
lines.english: Did this man—

lines.japanese: ──俺や鷲介に留まらず、タカシの存在まで掴んでると言うのか。
lines.english: —know not only about Shusuke and me, but even of Takashi's existence?

lines.japanese: 「なんで森里捨てたん」
lines.english: “Why'd you throw Morisato out?”

lines.japanese: 俺は目を逸らし、そして話を逸らした。
lines.english: I looked away and changed the subject.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！」
lines.english: “Ha!”

lines.japanese: やつは俺のそんな態度を──かどうかは知らないが、たやすく嘲笑った。
lines.english: He laughed easily at me—at my evasion, perhaps, or perhaps at something else.

lines.japanese: 「騒々しい牝豚が黄色い声で喚きたてる。和馬はふたたび青い空を目指すらしいじゃないか。そのとき俺の存在は、やつを灰色の曇天に留めるらしい」
lines.english: “A clamorous sow squealed it in my ear. It appears Kazuma means to seek the blue sky once more, while my presence would keep him beneath a gray and clouded one.”

lines.japanese: 「……受験を成功させるためか」
lines.english: “...So he can pass his entrance exams?”

lines.japanese: 「くだらない、知ったことかよ。だが、俺にはイヤープラグがない。カラスや小娘の鳴き声はいつも俺を不快にさせる」
lines.english: “Trifles. What do I care? But I have no earplugs. The cries of crows and little girls invariably offend me.”

lines.japanese: 「照れんなよ。てめ、バリバリドキュンのくせにいいとこあんじゃねえかコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “Don’t get all bashful. You’re a dyed-in-the-wool delinquent, but you’ve got a decent side after all, you bastard.”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ！　予想通りだぞ隼人！　やはり今宵も、おまえは庶民好みの美談にこじつけたか！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha! Just as I predicted, Hayato! Once again tonight, you have twisted events into the sort of heartwarming tale the common rabble adores!”

lines.japanese: 「だが生憎だったな？　じきに俺にはすべての兵が不要になる、そして和馬は俺に代わる新たな将を拒んだ──真実はたったそれだけのことだ」
lines.english: “But alas. Soon I shall have no need of any soldiers, and Kazuma refused the new commander who would take my place. That is the whole truth.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな、わけ分かんねえ照れかくしほざいてんじゃねえよ。んなことよりおまえ、Ｒ－ウィングの大司教の潜伏先とか掴んでねえのかよ。どうせ帰ってねえと思うけど、住所とか電話番号でもいい」
lines.english: “Shut up. Quit spouting incomprehensible bullshit to hide your embarrassment. More importantly, do you know where R-Wing's Archbishop is holed up? He's probably not home, but even an address or phone number would do.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう、今度はカラスに捨てられたオウムの話か。驚いたぞ隼人、おまえはいつから他人の存在を気にかけるつまらん男になり下がった」
lines.english: “Oh? Now we turn to the parrot the Crow abandoned. You astonish me, Hayato. When did you become dull enough to care what happens to other people?”

lines.japanese: 「ヤロウ、知ってんのか知らねえのか、とっとと答えろよ。お話タイムを待ちわびてたのは、おまえだけじゃねえんだよ。いちいち勿体つけんな」
lines.english: “Asshole, you know or you don't, so answer me already. You're not the only one who's been dying for story time. Quit making a production out of every damn thing.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう……？　成田隼人にしては珍しい顔をするじゃないか。何があった」
lines.english: “Oh...? What an unusual face for Hayato Narita. What happened?”

lines.japanese: 「仲間がやられた。俺の大事な仲間だ」
lines.english: “My friends got hurt. Friends who matter to me.”

lines.japanese: 「大事な仲間！　ハハ！」
lines.english: “Friends who matter to you! Ha!”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハ、愉快だぞ隼人！　おまえの口から、そんな薄ら寒い言葉の出る日が来ようとはな！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha ha! This is wonderful, Hayato! I never thought I’d hear anything so sickeningly sentimental come out of your mouth!”

lines.japanese: 「ボケが……笑いごとじゃねんだよ。こっちはマジギレ寸前なんだよ」
lines.english: “You moron... This isn't funny. I'm about two seconds from losing it.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう！　そいつは吉報！　おまえを昂ぶらせるにはそんなつまんねぇことで良かったのか！　ハハハ、こいつはとんだ盲点だ！」
lines.english: “Oh! Glad tidings! Was something so trivial all it took to set your blood racing? Ha ha ha! What a magnificent blind spot!”

lines.japanese: 「……笑いごとじゃねえっつってんだろ」
lines.english: “...I said it isn't funny.”

lines.japanese: 「無理を言うな、これを喜ばずに何を喜べと言う。この一年というもの、俺はおまえのその顔を夢にまで見ていたんだぞ！　ハハハ、眼福、眼福！」
lines.english: “Don't ask the impossible. If I cannot rejoice in this, what could bring me joy? For an entire year, I have dreamed of seeing that face! Ha ha ha! A feast for the eyes!”

lines.japanese: 「てめえ、何が面白ぇんだ……」
lines.english: “What the hell do you find so funny...?”

lines.japanese: 何を笑いとばしてるんだ、こいつは。
lines.english: What the hell was he laughing at?

lines.japanese: 首の後ろに鈍い痛みが這いのぼってくる。俺はこぶしを握りしめ、歯を食いしばって唱えた。
lines.english: A dull ache crawled up the back of my neck. I clenched my fists, gritted my teeth, and recited.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth.*

lines.japanese: 「てめえのイカれた戯れ言に付きあってる暇ねンだよ。オウムの居所を知ってんのか知らねえのか、そんだけ答えとけや腐れジャンキーが」
lines.english: “I don't have time for your deranged bullshit. Either you know where the parrot is or you don't. Just answer that, you rotten junkie.”

lines.japanese: 「ククク、知ってると言ったらどうするつもりだ？」
lines.english: “Heh. And what will you do if I say I know?”

lines.japanese: 「言え」
lines.english: “Tell me.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえがそれを知ってどうするつもりだ？」
lines.english: “What do you intend to do with that knowledge?”

lines.japanese: 「勿体つけんなっつってんだろ、てめえ」
lines.english: “I told you to quit dragging this out.”

lines.japanese: 「さあて、どうしたものかなあ」
lines.english: “Now, whatever shall I do?”

lines.japanese: 「ふざけんな、てめえ！」
lines.english: “Don’t screw with me, you bastard!”

lines.japanese: 俺は床を蹴り、テーブルを飛びこえ、なかば寝そべっている長身の上からその胸倉を掴んだ。
lines.english: I kicked off the floor, vaulted the table, and seized the half-reclining giant by the collar from above.

lines.japanese: 胸の内でくすぶっていた火が、ふたたび風を受けて赤く熱を発していた。どこかで誰かが嗤っている。
lines.english: The fire smoldering in my chest caught the wind and glowed red again. Somewhere, someone laughed.

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように。世界が平和でありますように。
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth. May peace prevail on Earth.*

lines.japanese: 「言えよ」
lines.english: “Tell me.”

lines.japanese: 「先に答えろ。オウムを捕えてどうするつもりだ」
lines.english: “Answer me first. What will you do once you catch the parrot?”

lines.japanese: 「知るか！　いいから言え！」
lines.english: “How should I know? Just tell me!”

lines.japanese: 「よくないだろう。警察には行ったのか？　おまえが手ずから捕えて、全体やつに何をしたいと言うんだ」
lines.english: “That will not do. Have you gone to the police? If you capture him with your own hands, what exactly do you want to do to him?”

lines.japanese: 「なあ、成田隼人。ファルコン。自分で気付いているか？　仲間をやられたと言うおまえの目に悲しみはない。あるのは憎悪と怨嗟の暗い埋み火だ。その怒りをもって、おまえは敵をどうしたいんだ」
lines.english: “Tell me, Hayato Narita. Falcon. Do you realize it yourself? You say your friends were hurt, yet there is no grief in your eyes. Only the dark embers of hatred and resentment, banked beneath the ash. With that anger, what do you wish to do to your enemy?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえよ。喋ってんじゃねえよ。んなこた聞いてねえ！　言え！　やつはどこだ！」
lines.english: “Shut up. Stop talking. I didn't ask for any of that! Tell me! Where is he?”

lines.japanese: 激情が喉からほとばしる。上顎と脳天のあいだを、甲虫の足で触れるようなむず痒さが這ってゆく。それは何かを俺に伝えたがっている、声ならぬ意思だった。
lines.english: Fury burst from my throat. An itch like beetle legs crept through the space between the roof of my mouth and the crown of my skull. It was a voiceless will straining to tell me something.

lines.japanese: “汝の敵を裁け”
lines.english: ‘Judge thine enemy.’

lines.japanese: 不快さに俺は頭を振ったが、それによって延髄に忍びよっていた鈍痛がいや増した。
lines.english: I shook my head against the disgust, but the movement only deepened the dull pain creeping into my medulla.

lines.japanese: 「殴りたいのか？　復讐したいのか？　制裁を加えたいのか？」
lines.english: “Do you want to strike him? Take revenge? Punish him?”

lines.japanese: 血が上り、体が震え、心が折れる。どこかで誰かが囁いている。
lines.english: Blood rushed to my head. My body shook. My spirit gave way. Somewhere, someone whispered.

lines.japanese: “汝の敵を裁け”
lines.english: Pass judgment on your enemy.

lines.japanese: 苛立ちは怒りに、怒りは憎しみに、そして憎しみは──
lines.english: Irritation became anger. Anger became hatred. And hatred—

lines.japanese: 「ブッ殺したいんだろ？」
lines.english: “You want to kill him, don't you?”

lines.japanese: 「うるせえっ！」
lines.english: “Shut up!”

lines.japanese: ──暴力に高じた。
lines.english: —became violence.

lines.japanese: 「くふっ！」
lines.english: “Kh!”

lines.japanese: 一瞬、意識が白く霞んだ──血の色の赤だったかもしれない。
lines.english: For one instant consciousness clouded white—or perhaps blood-red.

lines.japanese: 刹那、俺の右腕が眼下の笑う肉塊に突きたっていた。
lines.english: The next instant, my right arm was buried in the laughing mass of flesh below.

lines.japanese: “上出来だ”
lines.english: Well done.

lines.japanese: 「フッ……クク、ククク」
lines.english: “Hh... Heh, heh heh.”

lines.japanese: 「はあっ、はあっ、はあっ……」
lines.english: “Hah, hah, hah...”

lines.japanese: 俺は自分の起こした行動に──起こした記憶のない行動に慄然としていた。
lines.english: I recoiled from the act I had committed—from an act I had no memory of committing.

lines.japanese: 体は熱く火照っている。頭の内側を無数の粒がざらざら転がるようでこそばゆい。声なき意思との不可視の距離がさらに狭まってしまった──そう、直感した。
lines.english: My body burned. Countless grains seemed to roll and grate inside my skull, making it itch. The invisible distance between that voiceless will and me had narrowed again. I knew it instinctively.

lines.japanese: “上出来だ……が、それが貴様の限界だ”
lines.english: Well done... But that’s as far as you can go.

lines.japanese: “去ね。去んで玉座を余に空けよ、ファルコン”
lines.english: Begone. Begone and leave the throne to me, Falcon.

lines.japanese: 「うるせえええっ！」
lines.english: “Shut uuuuup!”

lines.japanese: むず痒さに俺は頭を掻きむしった。首の後ろはずきずきと痛み、肺は息苦しく空気を求めていた。
lines.english: I clawed at my head against the maddening itch. My neck throbbed; my lungs clenched, starving for air.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハハハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha ha ha ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 俺の暴力を受けとめた男は、血走った目を見開き、喘ぐように声高く笑っている。
lines.english: The man who had taken my blow opened his bloodshot eyes wide and laughed in a high, breathless voice.

lines.japanese: 「ハ──ッハッハッハ！　ハッ、ハッ、ハァッ！　ヒァ──ッヒャッヒャッヒャッヒャッ！」
lines.english: “Haaah-ha-ha-ha! Hah, hah, haaah! Hyaaa-ha-ha-ha-ha-ha!”

lines.japanese: 「ファルコォォォン！　貴様、いまイイ顔してるぜぇ！　俺ァ、俺ァ、エレクトしそうだァァァ！」
lines.english: “Falcoooon! Look at that face! I’m—I’m going to get hard!”

lines.japanese: 「黙れ！」
lines.english: “Shut up!”

lines.japanese: 俺は二発目の鉄拳を、やつの頭のすぐ横、オサレベンチの背もたれに叩きつけた。
lines.english: I slammed my second fist into the back of the pretentious bench, just beside his head.

lines.japanese: 「はあっ！　はあっ！　はあっ……！」
lines.english: “Hah! Hah! Hah...!”

lines.japanese: 呼吸……！　もっと呼吸を……！
lines.english: Breathe...! I needed more air...!

lines.japanese: 世界が平和でありますように！　世界が平和でありますように！
lines.english: *May peace prevail on Earth! May peace prevail on Earth!*

lines.japanese: 「イイんだぜぇ、もっと殴ってよぉ」
lines.english: “Come on, it’s fine. Hit me some more.”

lines.japanese: 「黙れ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「殴れよ」
lines.english: “Hit me.”

lines.japanese: 「黙れ」
lines.english: “Shut up.”

lines.japanese: 「殴っとけよ、オラもっともっともっともっともっとォォォ！！」
lines.english: “Go on, hit me! Come on, more, more, more, mooooore!”

lines.japanese: 「うる……せえええええっ！」
lines.english: “Shut... uuuuuup!”

lines.japanese: 俺は原始的な誘惑と血走った瞳に背を向け、安全靴の爪先でテーブルをすくいあげた。
lines.english: I turned my back on the primal temptation and those bloodshot eyes, hooked the toe of my safety boot under the table, and kicked it up.

lines.japanese: それはガラスの壁まで吹きとんで、耳障りな破砕音を爆発させた。
lines.english: It flew into the glass wall with an ear-splitting crash.

lines.japanese: 「はあっ、はあっ、はあっ……」
lines.english: “Hah... Hah... Hah...”

lines.japanese: 乱れた自らの息遣いを聞きながら、俺は固くまぶたを閉ざし、代わりにこぶしを開いた。
lines.english: Listening to my own ragged breath, I squeezed my eyes shut and opened my fists instead.

lines.japanese: 上顎と脳天のあいだの粒や甲虫は去っていた。首筋の鈍痛もゆっくり引いていった。そして──
lines.english: The grains and beetle legs between the roof of my mouth and the crown of my skull were gone. The dull ache in my neck slowly receded. And then—

lines.japanese: ──声なき意思も、去っていた。
lines.english: —the voiceless will was gone too.

lines.japanese: 「はぁ、はぁ、はぁ……」
lines.english: “Hah... hah... hah...”

lines.japanese: 俺は執拗に呼吸を繰りかえした。汗に濡れた着衣が背中に貼りついていた。
lines.english: I kept forcing breath after breath into my lungs. My sweat-soaked clothes clung to my back.

lines.japanese: 「迷えるなよ」
lines.english: “Don’t lose your way.”

lines.japanese: 視覚を遮断した俺の耳孔に、掠れたささやきが吹きこまれた。
lines.english: With my eyes shut, I heard a hoarse whisper close to my ear.

lines.japanese: 俺は目を開けて振りかえった。瞬間、猛禽の蹴爪が音もなく下から迫りあがってきた。
lines.english: I opened my eyes and turned. In that instant, a bird of prey's talons rose soundlessly toward me from below.

lines.japanese: 「くっ！」
lines.english: “Damn!”

lines.japanese: なかば力尽きていた俺には、それをかわす余力がなかった。鳳の三本の指が、俺の両頬を挟みこんで爪を立てた。
lines.english: Already half-spent, I had no strength left to evade them. Otori's three-fingered grip clamped around both my cheeks, nails digging in.

lines.japanese: だが、それは本気の膂力ではなかった。
lines.english: But he wasn't using anything close to his full strength.

lines.japanese: 「おまえの見るべきはそっちじゃねえだろ隼人……俺に背を向けるな……」
lines.english: “That isn't where you should be looking, Hayato... Don't turn your back on me...”

lines.japanese: 「足りねえよ……なあ、おい、あの眼で俺をもっと愛撫しろよ……」
lines.english: “It isn't enough... Come on. Caress me with those eyes some more...”

lines.japanese: 「はな……せ、よっ」
lines.english: “Let... go!”

lines.japanese: 俺は裏拳を打って鳳の拘束を解いた。やつは大袈裟に全身を飛びのかせ、低い位置で両手を広げた。
lines.english: I struck with the back of my fist and broke Otori's hold. He flung himself extravagantly backward, spreading both hands low.

lines.japanese: 「つれねえなあ……自分勝手に終わってんじゃねえよ」
lines.english: “So cold... Don't finish all by yourself.”

lines.japanese: そして長い舌をだらりと垂らし──
lines.english: Then he let his long tongue hang loose—

lines.japanese: 「ヘェーッエッエッエッ！　俺ァまだイッてねえんだよ！」
lines.english: “Heh-heh-heh-heh! I haven't come yet!”

lines.japanese: ──両翼を閉じるように前へ振りかざした。
lines.english: —and swung both arms forward like wings snapping shut.

lines.japanese: 俺は咄嗟に膝を落とした。掌底と掌底は俺の頭髪をかすめ、そのわずか上で埃くさい空気を音高く叩きつぶした。
lines.english: I dropped into a crouch on instinct. His palms struck each other just above my hair, crushing the dusty air with a crack.

lines.japanese: 「野郎ッ」
lines.english: “You bastard!”

lines.japanese: 俺は立ちあがりざま、脚の筋力も込めた渾身のアッパーブローを突きあげた。
lines.english: As I rose, I launched a full-force uppercut driven from the legs.
“Hah!”

lines.japanese: 鳳はごくわずかな差で身を反らした。瞬間、俺のボディが空いた。やつは見逃さず、そこへ遠慮のない一撃を突きこんだ。
lines.english: Otori arched away by the narrowest margin. For that instant, my midsection lay open, and he did not miss it. He buried a merciless blow there.

lines.japanese: 「がふっ！」
lines.english: “Guh!”

lines.japanese: 呼気が漏れ、痛みとも認識できない衝撃が体の中心に深々と打ちこまれた。
lines.english: My breath burst out. An impact too deep even to register as pain drove into the center of my body.

lines.japanese: 「ハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: やつは俺の腹に掌底を埋めこんだまま、体重をかけるように前へ踏みだす。俺は重心を失い後ろへ倒れそうになったが、その前に硬い壁が俺の背中を抱きとめた。
lines.english: Keeping his palm heel buried in my stomach, he stepped in and put his weight behind it. I lost my balance and nearly fell backward, but the hard wall caught me first.

lines.japanese: 「うっ」
lines.english: “Ugh!”

lines.japanese: 「ハハハ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: 俺を壁に打ちつけると、鳳は短く腕を引きぬき、しかしすぐさま腰のひねりを加えた逆の腕を同じ場所に突きたてた。
lines.english: He slammed me into the wall, drew the arm back only inches, then drove the other into the same place with a twist of his hips.

lines.japanese: 「ぐぶっ！」
lines.english: “Gubh!”

lines.japanese: 肺の中のものがすべて漏れた。痛みと吐き気と息苦しさとで前後不覚に陥ったまま、俺の体はずるずると壁づたいに崩れていった。
lines.english: Every last breath escaped me. Dazed by pain and nausea and unable to breathe, I slid down the wall.

lines.japanese: 「なんだそれは？」
lines.english: “What is this?”

lines.japanese: わけの分からない混濁した意識の中、やつの低い掠れ声が上から降ってきた。
lines.english: Through the haze in my head, his low, hoarse voice came down from above.

lines.japanese: 「あァ？　まさかこれで仕舞いじゃねえよなあ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Don't tell me you're finished already.”

lines.japanese: 熱く燃える指が、俺の首を下から掴んだ。顎にかけたその指は、小刻みに震えながら上向きの力を奮った。俺の視野も引きおこされた。
lines.english: Burning fingers seized my throat from below. Hooked under my jaw, they trembled as they forced upward. My vision rose with them.

lines.japanese: 「違うだろ！　こんなもんじゃねえだろ貴様！」
lines.english: “No! This isn't all you've got!”

lines.japanese: 頭が下から押しあげられる──体ごとだ！
lines.english: My head was being forced upward—my entire body with it!

lines.japanese: やつの腕の震えがいっそう激しくなった。袖の下から覗いた手首に血管が盛りあがり、筋肉は鋼鉄の柱のように強張った。
lines.english: His arm shook harder. Veins stood along the wrist exposed beneath his sleeve; his muscles hardened into a pillar of steel.

lines.japanese: やがて力なく垂れた俺の足は床を離れた。もはや俺の体は壁に貼りつけられ、宙に浮かされていた。
lines.english: At last my powerless feet left the floor. My body was pinned against the wall and lifted into the air.

lines.japanese: 「そのザマはなんだ、ファルコンンン！　貴様、カラスにも劣るじゃねえか！」
lines.english: “What is this disgrace, Falcoooon? You're worse than the Crow!”

lines.japanese: 「成田隼人！　その脆弱さで、貴様は貴様の仲間とやらを守ることが出来るのか！　ええ！」
lines.english: “Hayato Narita! With strength this feeble, can you protect those so-called friends of yours? Well?”

lines.japanese: いつも俺を見下ろしていたあの血走った目が、いまは自分より低い位置にあった。何か言いかえしたかったが、自らの重みが喉を圧迫していて、まともに声を出すことも敵わなかった。
lines.english: Those bloodshot eyes that had always looked down on me were now below mine. I wanted to answer, but my own weight was crushing my throat. I could not force out a word.

lines.japanese: 俺は言葉にならない喘ぎをもらした。重いまぶたをこじ開けて、やつの狂った目を見下ろした。一瞬、やつは期待に顔をほころばせた。
lines.english: A wordless gasp escaped me. I forced my heavy lids apart and looked down into his mad eyes. For one instant, expectation lit his face.

lines.japanese: 「ハハ……ハハハハハ！」
lines.english: “Ha ha... Ha ha ha ha ha!”

lines.japanese: しかし俺が力尽きて目を伏せると──
lines.english: But when my strength gave out and I lowered my eyes—

lines.japanese: ──音高く息を吸いこみ、吸いこみ、吸いこみ、最後に俺を床の上に投げすてた。
lines.english: —he drew one loud breath, then another, another, and finally flung me onto the floor.

lines.japanese: 「げふっ──っはあ！　っはあ、っはあ、っはあ！」
lines.english: “Guh—hah! Hah... hah... hah!”

lines.japanese: 俺は身を折ってうずくまりながら、のたうち回るように空気を吸いこんだ。
lines.english: I doubled over and writhed, dragging air into my lungs.

lines.japanese: 「ハッ！　無様だな成田隼人、醜い男よ！　おまえは不細工だ、魂が不細工だ！」
lines.english: “Ha! How wretched, Hayato Narita! What an ugly man! You are hideous—hideous in your very soul!”

lines.japanese: 「ううっ……」
鳳のブーツの先端が腹の下に潜りこんで、俺の体はたやすく裏返された。
lines.english: The toe of Otori's boot slipped beneath my stomach and rolled me effortlessly onto my back.

lines.japanese: 「満たされねえ」
lines.english: “I'm not satisfied.”

lines.japanese: やつは俺の腹にブーツの底を置き、顔を近づけるように腰を曲げた。その膝の上に肘を載せ、俺の目を真上から覗きこむ。
lines.english: He planted the sole of his boot on my stomach and bent at the waist to bring his face close. Resting one elbow on his knee, he peered straight down into my eyes.

lines.japanese: 「おまえじゃ満たされねえ」
lines.english: “You’re not enough.”

lines.japanese: まるで見せつけるように、鳳は右手を大きく振りかぶった。三本の指が凶暴な口を開けて牙を剥いていた。
lines.english: Making a spectacle of it, Otori swept his right hand high overhead. Three fingers opened into a savage maw and bared its fangs.

lines.japanese: いま抵抗しても無駄だと知って、俺は痛みにうめく以外の行動を見せなかった。
lines.english: Knowing resistance was useless now, I did nothing but groan in pain.

lines.japanese: 「やつに換われえええ！　おまえじゃ勃たねえええ！」
lines.english: “Give way to him! You can't even get me hard!”

lines.japanese: 燃える猛禽の蹴爪が真っ逆さまに空を突きやぶってきた。
lines.english: The burning talons of the bird of prey plunged headlong through the air.

lines.japanese: 俺はいまこそ目を見開き、寸前の寸前まで引きつけてから首を横へ流した。
lines.english: Only then did I open my eyes wide. I let the strike come within a final hair's breadth, then slipped my head aside.

lines.japanese: 「ぐぅっ！」
lines.english: “Ghh!”

lines.japanese: 渾身の力で床を殴った鳳が、瞬間、苦痛にうめいた。すぐさま俺はやつのくるぶしに足払いをかけた。
lines.english: Otori’s fist hit the floor with all his strength, and he groaned in pain. I swept his ankle at once.

lines.japanese: 「ちっ！」
lines.english: “Tch!”

lines.japanese: 平衡を失った長身が、のしかかるように崩れてくる。代わって俺は、やつの体を下からかち上げるように身を起こした。
lines.english: His tall frame lost balance and came crashing down over me. I surged up beneath him and drove him back.

lines.japanese: 不安定な姿勢のまま俺と衝突した鳳は、片足を踏んばって転倒を免れた──しかしその瞬間、全身の隙を虚しく曝けだしていた。
lines.english: Otori collided with me off balance and braced one foot to keep from falling. In that instant, he left himself completely open.

lines.japanese: 「るぁぁぁ！」
lines.english: “Raaagh!”

lines.japanese: 俺は溜めていたなけなしの力を振りしぼって、えぐるような右こぶしをやつの腹に──
lines.english: I wrung out my last reserve and drove a gouging right toward his stomach—

lines.japanese: ──叩きこむ寸前で、止めた。
lines.english: —then stopped just before it landed.

lines.japanese: 「ぺッ」
lines.english: “Ptuh.”

lines.japanese: 代わりにやつの顔面へ唾を吐いた。そして、そのまますれ違うように体を流して間合いを取った。
lines.english: Instead, I spat in his face. In the same motion, I slipped past him and opened the distance between us.

lines.japanese: やつは体勢を立てなおすと、袖口で赤みの混じった汚物を拭った。奇妙な表情が凍りついていた。
lines.english: He recovered his stance and wiped the blood-tinged filth from his face with his cuff. A strange expression had frozen there.

lines.japanese: 「へっ、タコが。ンな安っぽい挑発に乗るかよ」
lines.english: “Heh. Dumbass. Like I'd take bait that cheap.”

lines.japanese: 「クク……そう来たか……」
lines.english: “Heh... So that’s your answer...”

lines.japanese: 「早漏め、ひとりでさっさと達したみたいだなあ。おまえは本当につまらない男だ」
lines.english: “You premature bastard. Went and finished all by yourself, huh? You really are a boring man.”

lines.japanese: 「っせえな。だから挑発すんなっつの」
lines.english: “Shut up. I told you to quit baiting me.”

lines.japanese: 俺は痛む腹を押さえながら、どすんと床に尻を落とし、目に見えて落胆する男に二本指を突きつけた。目潰しピース。
lines.english: Holding my aching stomach, I dropped heavily onto my ass and thrust two fingers at the visibly crestfallen man—a peace sign aimed at his eyes.

lines.japanese: 「俺のハートは震えない」
lines.english: “My heart isn’t trembling.”

lines.japanese: 「やめろ。バッドに入る」
lines.english: “Stop that. You'll send me into a bad trip.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は肩を落としてのろのろと歩き、元いた席にどっかり沈みこんだ。
lines.english: Shoulders slumped, Otori trudged back to his old seat and sank heavily into it.

lines.japanese: 「おい」
lines.english: “Hey.”

lines.japanese: やつは穴の開いたガラスの向こうに呼びかけ、ぱちんと指を鳴らした。次いで頭上に右こぶしと左こぶしを掲げ、それぞれを違える方向にひねってみせた。おしぼり一丁のサイン。
lines.english: He called through the hole in the glass and snapped his fingers. Then he raised both fists overhead and twisted them in opposite directions: the signal for one wet towel.

lines.japanese: 客が好き放題暴れても何ひとつ言わなかった店員が、すぐに濡れタオルを一本持って駆けより、バカ殿の傍らに片膝をついた。
lines.english: The staff had said nothing while a customer rampaged at will, yet one of them immediately hurried over with a wet towel and knelt beside the idiot lord.

lines.japanese: 鳳が小声で店員に指示を出す。店員はすぐさま動きだした。倒れたテーブルを脇へ運び、砕けたガラスの破片を拾う。
lines.english: Otori gave quiet instructions. The employee immediately carried aside the overturned table and began gathering shards.

lines.japanese: 鳳は手品師のような手つきでフェイスタオルを広げ、汚れた顔面を拭った。
lines.english: With a magician's flourish, Otori opened the face towel and wiped his filthy face.

lines.japanese: 「隼人、答えよう。オウムの所在など知らん」
lines.english: “Hayato, I shall answer you. I know nothing of the parrot's whereabouts.”

lines.japanese: 出し抜けに言って、使いおわったものを俺に放る。汚ねえ。すぐに俺はアンダースロウで掃除中の店員へ返した。
lines.english: He announced this without warning and tossed the used towel at me. Filthy. I immediately tossed it underhand to the employee cleaning up.

lines.japanese: 「本当か。本当に知らねえのか」
lines.english: “Is that true? You really don't know?”

lines.japanese: 「隠してどうなる。そもそも、やつはまだこの街にいるのか？　俺はそこにこそ疑問を感じるがな」
lines.english: “What would I gain by hiding it? For that matter, is he even still in this city? That’s what I wonder.”

lines.japanese: 「言っただろ、俺の仲間がやられてんだよ。ひとりは今日。つか、まだ何時間も経ってねえ。場所はヤナポリ広場」
lines.english: “I told you, he got to my people. One of them today—hell, it hasn't even been a few hours. Yanapoli Plaza.”

lines.japanese: 「フン……いいだろう。元はと言えば俺にたかった蝿だ。調べさせておこう」
lines.english: “Hmph... Very well. He was a fly buzzing around me to begin with. I shall have it investigated.”

lines.japanese: 俺は両腕を支えに体を起こし、まだ痛む腹を押さえながら元の席へ歩いていった。
lines.english: I pushed myself up on both arms, then walked back to my old seat with one hand pressed to my still-aching stomach.

lines.japanese: 「隼人、やつを捕えたらどうするつもりだ」
lines.english: “Hayato. What do you intend to do when you catch him?”

lines.japanese: 鳳がまた同じ問いを投げかけてきた。俺は下を向きながらベンチに腰を落とした。
lines.english: Otori put the same question to me again. Looking down, I lowered myself onto the bench.

lines.japanese: 「べつに……」
lines.english: “Nothing.”

lines.japanese: 半身を折ったとき、脇腹がぎゅるりと痛んだ。
lines.english: Pain twisted through my side as I bent to sit.

lines.japanese: 「べつに、どうもしねえよ。そんなん、交番に突きだすだけだろ」
lines.english: “Nothing. I'm not going to do anything. I'll just hand him over to the nearest police box.”

lines.japanese: 「ほう？」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: テーブルのなくなった間抜けな空間を挟んで、鳳は長い脚を優雅に組みかえた。
lines.english: Across the ridiculous empty space where the table had been, Otori elegantly crossed his long legs the other way.

lines.japanese: 「模範的な回答だな。だが、どうだかな、そんな理由のためにおまえは昂ぶっていたのか？」
lines.english: “An exemplary answer. And yet I wonder: was that truly why you were so worked up?”

lines.japanese: 「当たりめえだろ。俺はただ、警察に任せて自分は家でゴロ寝とか、そんなん出来ねえだけだ」
lines.english: “Obviously. I just can't dump it in the cops' laps and go lounge around at home.”

lines.japanese: 「なるほど、もっともらしいな。いま考えついたにしてはよく出来ている」
lines.english: “I see. Plausible enough. Remarkably well made for something you invented just now.”

lines.japanese: 「……違ぇよ。ハナからそのつもりだっつうの」
lines.english: “...That's not it. That was my plan from the start.”

lines.japanese: 俺は膝を叩いて立ちあがった。ここにいてもオウムの手がかりが得られないなら、これ以上時間を浪費することはない。
lines.english: I slapped my knee and stood. If there were no clues to the parrot here, I had no reason to waste another moment.

lines.japanese: 「待てよ」
lines.english: “Wait.”

lines.japanese: 「待たねえよ。こっちの話は済んだ。邪魔したな」
lines.english: “No. My business is done. Sorry to bother you.”

lines.japanese: 「白々しい」
lines.english: “Spare me.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は顔を斜めに向け、睨むように俺を見上げた。
lines.english: Otori angled his face and glared up at me.

lines.japanese: 「座れよ。おまえは俺に尋ねごとがあってここに来たんじゃない。俺がおまえを呼びつけたからここにいるんだ」
lines.english: “Sit. You are not here because you had questions for me. You are here because I summoned you.”

lines.japanese: ばれたか。俺は座りなおして後ろ頭をがしがし掻いた。
lines.english: So he caught me. I sat back down and scratched hard at the back of my head.

lines.japanese: 「なんだっけ。話あるっつったっけ」
lines.english: “What was it again? You said you had something to tell me?”

lines.japanese: 「そうだ」
lines.english: “I did.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は二本指で片眉を隠すような頬杖をついた。
lines.english: Otori propped his cheek on one hand, two fingers masking an eyebrow.

lines.japanese: 「一年……おまえらに逢ってから約一年が経った……」
lines.english: “One year... Nearly one year has passed since I met all of you...”

lines.japanese: 「あー、ごめん、ちょっと待って。回想シーン入りかけてるとこ悪いんだけど、その話はあの糞オウムに関係あんの」
lines.english: “Ah, sorry, hang on. Hate to interrupt just as the flashback's starting, but does this story have anything to do with that fucking parrot?”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿を言うな。俺たちの年表にあの男の名など記される余地もない」
lines.english: “Don't be absurd. There is no room in our chronicle for that man's name.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そう。じゃあ悪いんだけど、また今度にしてくんない。正直いま俺、アレのことでいっぱいいっぱいだから」
lines.english: “Oh. Then sorry, but can we do this some other time? Honestly, that's all I have room for in my head right now.”

lines.japanese: 俺はいまの心境を包みかくさず告げた。心身ともに疲弊していた。いくらかは鳳のせいだから、俺は強気に出ることができた。
lines.english: I told him exactly how I felt. I was exhausted in body and mind. Otori bore some of the blame, so I could afford to stand my ground.

lines.japanese: 「なんだと。話が違う。俺はおまえの要望通り、鳴という女の情報を渡したはずだ」
lines.english: “What? That was not our agreement. I gave you the information about the woman named Naru, exactly as you requested.”

lines.japanese: 「だから」
lines.english: “Exactly.”

lines.japanese: 俺は膝に手を置いて身を乗りだした。
lines.english: I planted my hands on my knees and leaned forward.

lines.japanese: 「アレが野放しンなってるうちは鳴だって危ねえんだよ」
lines.english: “As long as that bastard's still loose, Naru's in danger too.”

lines.japanese: 鳳は一度まぶたを閉じた。眉間に皺を刻み、顎を小刻みに震わせながら斜めに傾けた。
lines.english: Otori closed his eyes. A furrow cut between his brows; his jaw trembling in tiny spasms, he cocked his head.

lines.japanese: 数呼吸ほど置いて、やつはその不自然な角度からうっすらと目を開けた。
lines.english: After several breaths, he opened his eyes a sliver from that unnatural angle.

lines.japanese: 「いいだろう、保留としておこう。だが──」
lines.english: “Very well. We shall postpone it. But—”

lines.japanese: やつは鋭い眼光を放ち、笑わない声で言った。
lines.english: His gaze sharpened, and he spoke without the slightest trace of laughter.

lines.japanese: 「──そう長くは待たねえぞ。自覚してるか知らねえが、それはおまえら自身の都合でもあるはずだ」
lines.english: “I won’t wait long. Whether you realize it or not, this is in your interests too—all of you.”

lines.japanese: 俺は血の味のする生唾を呑みくだしてから答えた。
lines.english: I swallowed spit that tasted of blood before answering.

lines.japanese: 「分かった」
lines.english: “Got it.”

lines.japanese: いや、分かっていた。
lines.english: No. I already understood.

lines.japanese: そんな予感はしていた。
lines.english: I'd felt it coming.

lines.japanese: 均衡の取れた俺たちの天秤が、傾こうとしている予感。
lines.english: The scales that had kept us in balance were beginning to tip.

lines.japanese: だって、おまえの存在そのものが兆候のひとつなんだろう？
lines.english: Because your very existence is one of the signs, isn't it?

lines.japanese: なあ、名前も知らない誰かさん。
lines.english: Hey, you. The one whose name I don't even know.
